Markets

Equities · yields · oil

Indexes rise Friday, still finish week lower

Dow +0.98% to 53,277 · S&P +0.43% to 7,674 · Nasdaq +0.44%. Bond yields and Iran risk weighed on the week.

Bitcoin tops $77,000

Heading toward its strongest weekly rally since 2023 as crypto names also climbed.

Oil firm on Middle East uncertainty

Brent rose for the week; energy mixed while materials led sector gains Friday.

Elon · SpaceX · Tesla

Launch · AI · vehicles

Tesla–SpaceX merger talk stays active

Musk continues to cite growing overlap on Terafab, Starlink, and AI infrastructure; “appropriate process” still required.

SpaceX public and building AI compute

Recent results showed strong Starlink + AI revenue growth; heavy capex for data-center chips continues.

Cursor / Anysphere deal closed

SpaceX completed the coding-platform acquisition earlier this month as part of its AI stack build-out.

Tech & AI

Models · agents · infra

Anthropic revenue continues rapid climb

Recent prints showed multi-fold year-over-year growth; large compute deals keep expanding capacity.

Nvidia capacity deals remain center stage

Labs lock in long-term GPU and cloud commitments; investor focus stays on AI infrastructure spend.

Agent and robotics push accelerates

Multiple frontier labs expanding physical-world and long-horizon agent teams into late 2026.

Science

Space · labs · discovery

JWST finds more mass hidden in early galaxies

Small-star populations higher than expected; galaxies may be significantly more massive than prior estimates.

Water and dust survive near Sgr A*

Webb detected intact water molecules and silicate dust around a giant star only 0.55 light-years from the galactic black hole.

“Black hole star” candidate reported

Nature paper describes a dense hydrogen envelope powered by an accreting black hole — possible explanation for some JWST Little Red Dots.

Trump Admin

Policy · Iran · ballroom

Chief Justice allows White House ballroom work to continue

Temporary green light while lower-court challenges over congressional approval continue.

Iran “economic warfare” plan due Monday

Treasury Secretary Bessent says new actions aim to “squash” the Iranian economy; details expected next week.

Canada tariff deadline extended again

50% levy on roughly $20B of Canadian goods paused while final papers are negotiated.

UAP / UFOs

Disclosure · sensors · files

Pentagon releases 40+ additional UAP videos

New batch requested by lawmakers includes Lake Huron post-balloon and foreign-sub monitoring clips.

“Cold orbs” AC-130 footage still circulating

Earlier release showed erratic infrared objects over the Gulf of Oman; report compared motion to a dolphin pod.

Fifth tranche keeps focus on unresolved cases

AARO continues releasing mixed resolved and open-archive material under the ongoing disclosure effort.

Trending

Crypto · oil · fiscal

Bitcoin’s best week in years

BTC crossed $77k; crypto-related equities also advanced as yields stabilized late in the week.

U.S. debt attention remains elevated

$40 trillion milestone and long-end yield moves kept fiscal risk in the conversation.

Thin summer volume, quiet Friday

Trading light into the weekend; focus shifts to Monday’s Iran policy details and upcoming data.
